scopes.title: JPL Keplerian-element formulas
scopes.review_scope: Kepler equation and orbital-plane Cartesian conversion inspected only. No planetary fitting coefficients or approximate planetary ephemeris used. Fixed two-body positions/velocities are independently derived.

scopes.title: Geometric numerical integration illustrated by the Störmer–Verlet method
scopes.review_scope: Author/publisher metadata only; author PDF unavailable. KDK composition and reversibility are independently derived here; no original full-text audit or BH symplecticity claim.

scopes.title: On the Problem of Distribution in Globular Star Clusters
scopes.review_scope: Bibliography inherited from prior scoped source review; original full text not read. The finite32-body cold initial condition is density-derived, not an equilibrium Plummer DF or exact continuum flow.

scopes.title: galpy official Plummer potential definition
scopes.review_scope: Official potential normalization read in preparatory source review. No galpy execution; density scale1 and pair softening.05 are distinct parameters.

scopes.title: SciPy1.14.1 solve_ivp
